access_token.label: Bangumi personal access token
access_token.description: Generate at next.bgm.tv/demo/access-token while logged into bgm.tv (valid about one year). When set, your own collections (including private) are read. When empty, a username below is used to read public collections anonymously.

username.label: Username
username.description: Used to read public collections anonymously when no access token is set, e.g. sai.

refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often to refresh tracking data automatically.

show_covers.label: Show covers
show_covers.description: Show subject covers in the desktop widget.

widget_width.label: Content width
widget_width.description: Natural desktop widget width in logical pixels. Do not resize its tile in the desktop editor, or the host will still scale the content proportionally.

visible_items.label: Visible items
visible_items.description: Number of rows per desktop page; use the previous and next buttons to browse the rest.

bar.tooltip_not_configured: Not configured: add an access token or username in plugin settings
bar.tooltip_unauthorized: Access token is invalid or expired, update it in plugin settings
bar.tooltip_unwatched: {count} newly unwatched since the last progress update ({series} watching)
bar.tooltip_all_caught_up: No newly unwatched episodes since the last progress update ({series} watching)

desktop.title: Bangumi Tracking
desktop.not_configured: Not configured: add a Bangumi access token or username in plugin settings
desktop.unauthorized: Access token is invalid or expired, update it in plugin settings

panel.title: Bangumi Tracking
panel.not_configured_hint: Bangumi is not configured yet. Add a personal access token (recommended) or a username (public collections only) in plugin settings.
